reviewer: Codex assistant; exact assistant checkpoint not exposed
limitation: The assistant also implemented the system and saw its outputs. These are real AI judgments, not PESO staff ratings. Reused historical cases are exploratory after corrective prompt changes; no accuracy or population improvement claim.

feature_findings.supported: Evidence IDs/quotes and supplied training ID 501 match the synthetic input records. The English outputs identify Excel/license evidence as not stated.
feature_findings.issues: Filipino 'kaunting karanasan' adds an unsupported estimate of experience amount. 'Lisensyadong kapasyahan' is awkward/incorrect phrasing. 'Enroll' steps should first require provider availability confirmation; synthetic ID 501 is not a production training link.

feature_findings.evidence: Source says 'No teaching license is declared.'
feature_findings.issues: Historical prose calls this lack/absence and, in heldout-en, disqualification. Missing evidence is not evidence of absence; writing feedback must not decide qualification. No rewritten statements were returned, so fact-preserving rewrites are not established by these cases.

feature_findings.evidence: Source says generic spreadsheet files, without naming software.
feature_findings.issues: Relevance prose infers Microsoft Excel capability from spreadsheet work. The actual software should be a question, not an asserted candidate fact.

feature_findings.supported: Feedback quotes are actual supplied answer substrings and rubric categories are present.
feature_findings.issues: Comments infer Excel usage from generic spreadsheets. Historical opening feedback predates the final question-only protocol. These cases cannot validate the final opening contract.

feature_findings.supported: Follow-up asks about relevant teaching duties; quoted attendance/spreadsheet evidence is authentic.
feature_findings.issues: Advice should condition teaching examples on real experience. Conditional license requirements should not be expanded into unconditional eligibility claims.

feature_findings.supported: Both actual route-test sessions completed five answers, start with empty feedback and end with a final summary.
feature_findings.issues: All five questions repeat verbatim within each session. Repeated answers justify clarification, not an unchanged question. Passing sequence/schema tests alone missed this quality defect.

feature_findings.supported: Records work is grounded in the synthetic profile, education is requested rather than invented, and hydrated training IDs/links correspond to the transient synthetic database used by the test.
feature_findings.issues: No accepted rewrite in either case; one English suggestion was withheld. These records do not establish rewrite effectiveness, real provider slots or reviewer language ratings.
